_doc: Screens sim-screens.py checks, in order. name is what -RMScreenDriver opens (ViewController.m, simOpenScreen; panel:<rail tooltip> opens a plugin side panel). settle: seconds to wait after the app reports the screen ready. A screen passes when at most maxPctDiffering % of its pixels differ from the golden by more than threshold in any channel (2 absorbs the compositor's off-by-one antialiasing on rounded corners; a changed label differs by ~200). network: the screen shows live Plugin Hub data, which changes whenever the hub publishes, so it runs only when named.
